title: On Relieving the pain within an hour
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：relieve　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 relieve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the builder ① relieved the pain within an hour in silence, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② relieves the pain within an hour twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ relieve the pain within an hour at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ relieved the pain within an hour before — a line in the plan for October 1952 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Relieving the pain within an hour in silence, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ relieve the watchman at midnight twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Relieve the watchman at midnight at once and never mention it again.

By 1965 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ relieves the watchman at midnight in silence every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ relieved the pain within an hour again when nobody else would.

⑩ To relieve the pain within an hour, my mother said in 1970, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody relieves the pain within an hour twice over again and somebody must relieve the pain within an hour in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 缓解（一般过去式 relieved the pain within an hour：1958 年施工员头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 缓解（一般现在 relieves the pain within an hour：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 缓解（不定式 to relieve the pain within an hour：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 缓解（过去完成时 had relieved the pain within an hour：1952 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 缓解（动名词 relieving the pain within an hour 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 接替（relieve the watchman at midnight：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去接替半夜接替那位守夜人）
G. v. 接替（relieve the watchman at midnight：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 缓解（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 relieves the watchman at midnight，而母亲又一次 relieved the pain within an hour）

relieve 意为“缓解”，自那以后施工员来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 relieves。
relieve 意为“缓解”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯缓解一个钟头内把疼痛缓解下来”，此处为不定式 to relieve the pain within an hour。
relieve 意为“缓解”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1965 年之前就有人缓解过，故用过去完成时 had relieved。
relieve 意为“缓解”，施工员说“缓解一个钟头内把疼痛缓解下来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 relieving the pain within an hour 作主语。
relieve 意为“接替”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去接替半夜接替那位守夜人”，should ever 之后用原形 relieve the watchman at midnight。
relieve 意为“接替”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻接替半夜接替那位守夜人（relieve the watchman at midnight at once），以后再也不要提起。
relieve 意为“缓解”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例接替半夜接替那位守夜人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 relieves。
relieve 意为“缓解”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地缓解一个钟头内把疼痛缓解下来，用一般过去式 relieved 叙述。
relieve 意为“缓解”，结尾那句是母亲 1970 年的话：要缓解一个钟头内把疼痛缓解下来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 relieve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the builder relieved the pain within an hour in silence, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder relieves the pain within an hour twice over whenever the site asks.
Relieving the pain within an hour in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever relieve the watchman at midnight twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site relieves the watchman at midnight in silence every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother relieved the pain within an hour again, and the site remembered that half.
